dialogues.speaker: Korsakov
dialogues.text: Get a little closer! Closer! Otherwise we won't fit that whole catch in the frame... That monster is the star of the show for this interview!

dialogues.speaker: Korsakov
dialogues.text: Pictures? This is far more than just a few pictures. It's a full-blown feature article! I've already convinced my editor-in-chief to grant me a full spread to tell the legendary tales of the Morepesok fishermen!

dialogues.speaker: Korsakov
dialogues.text: And if I can just tie them back to Master Childe, who once hailed from these very shores... Well, a true masterpiece capturing the unyielding Snezhnayan spirit will come to life!

dialogues.speaker: Korsakov
dialogues.text: Morepesok really is my lucky harbor. My article on the local barbecue stall was a massive hit, too!

dialogues.speaker: Korsakov
dialogues.text: Haha, no worries! I mean, you were blocking my light a bit, but it's fine. Composition... no, the content of the composition is what really matters here!
